TERMS.INTRO: These terms govern the use of StayManager and its paid and free plans.
TERMS.SECTION_1_BODY: You are responsible for the activity in your account and workspace. Keep your access credentials secure and ensure data entered by your team is accurate and lawful.
TERMS.SECTION_2_BODY: Plan pricing is displayed publicly in USD unless stated otherwise. Paid plans may require manual payment verification before full dashboard access is enabled. Access and limits are based on your active plan.
TERMS.SECTION_3_BODY: Do not use StayManager to store unlawful content, violate third-party rights, or attempt unauthorized access to other users or workspaces. Abuse, scraping, or security bypass attempts are prohibited.

TERMS.SECTION_5_BODY: Policy updates may be published on this page. Continued use of StayManager after updates means you accept the revised terms.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.INTRO: This policy explains what information StayManager collects and how it is used.
PRIVACY.SECTION_1_BODY: We process account profile details, workspace configuration, reservations, and operational metadata needed to run the service.
PRIVACY.SECTION_2_BODY: Data is used to provide booking workflows, secure account access, operate dashboards, and improve product reliability and support.
PRIVACY.SECTION_3_BODY: We do not sell your personal data. Access is restricted by application permissions and Firestore security rules. Platform administrators may access only what is required for support and service operations.
PRIVACY.SECTION_4_BODY: StayManager uses Firebase services with authentication and database security rules. You should also protect your own account devices and credentials.
PRIVACY.SECTION_5_BODY: You can request updates or removal of your workspace information through the account owner. Continued use confirms acceptance of this privacy policy.
